name: shared-helper-owner-search

Focused catalog checks searched callable names only. Extend the shared collection identity matrix to require owner-title search when displayed names differ; the normal Reports unit suite enforces it.

2e645a55 fails owner-title search in the collection identity matrix and all three existing 1000-row responsive console scenarios. Browser failure screenshots retained in /tmp/harness-helper-owner-before-tablet.png.

Keep callable names for display and ordering while including the owning entity name in search. The shared identity matrix and existing scale scenario guard aliases; document both as catalog acceptance requirements.
